name: Black Pepper Powder
shortDescription: Premium finely ground black pepper with a robust, spicy flavor.
description: Our Black Pepper Powder is sourced from the finest pepper vines, delivering an intense aroma and sharp, penetrating flavor. Essential for almost every savory dish.

name: Mango Powder (Amchoor)
shortDescription: Tangy and fruity powder made from dried unripe green mangoes.
description: Amchoor is a fruity spice powder that adds a honey-like fragrance and sour fruity flavor without adding moisture. Perfect for marinades and curries.
benefits: High in Vitamin A and C

name: Turmeric Powder
shortDescription: Vibrant yellow spice with a warm, bitter taste and golden color.
description: Our Turmeric Powder is ground from high-quality, sun-dried turmeric root. Known for its brilliant golden color and earthy flavor, it's a staple in Indian cooking.

name: Red Chilli Powder
shortDescription: Fiery and intensely colored red chilli powder for that perfect heat.
description: Add vibrant color and sharp heat to your dishes with our premium Red Chilli Powder. Specially blended for the perfect balance of heat and flavor.

name: Coriander Powder
shortDescription: Mild, sweet, and citrusy flavor profile essential for curries.
description: Ground from roasted coriander seeds, this versatile spice adds a mild, earthy, and sweet note to curries, stews, and marinades.

name: Cumin Powder
shortDescription: Earthy, nutty, and warm spice perfect for hearty dishes.
description: Made from freshly roasted cumin seeds to release maximum essential oils. Essential for Mexican, Indian, and Middle Eastern cuisines.
benefits: May help with blood sugar control

name: Garam Masala
shortDescription: A warming blend of premium aromatic spices.
description: Our signature Garam Masala is a traditional blend of roasted whole spices. A pinch adds incredible depth and aroma to any dish.

name: Kitchen King Masala
shortDescription: The ultimate versatile spice blend for everyday cooking.
description: A complex blend of over 15 spices. Kitchen King Masala is your go-to spice mix for paneer, vegetables, and rich gravies.
